text: Being here, I feel like I am on the threshold between the familiar sterility of modern architecture and the vibrant promise of human creativity and knowledge. The first space is clean, reflective, almost meditative—a blank slate where possibilities dwell quietly. Shifting into the second space, the bold colors and words leap out to greet me, sparking curiosity and excitement. I am reminded of the duality of order and inspiration, as if reason and imagination are asking me to walk with both.
